## MARKET SUMMARY

## INDIA

The Indian ship recycling market has started to regain momentum following the five-day Diwali holiday break, with market activity gradually picking up. Local steel demand is expected to improve as markets return to normal operations, supporting renewed buying interest among recyclers. Buying indications are expected to strengthen further in the coming week as demand improves and market activity gathers pace.
